question: The Ultimate Kho-Kho League was started in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ultimate Kho-Kho League was started in the year **2022**.
 
• This league is a significant step towards popularizing the traditional Indian sport of Kho-Kho at a national and international level.
 
• The league features teams from various regions of India, promoting regional talent and providing a platform for athletes to showcase their skills.
 
• It aims to professionalize the sport and bring it to the mainstream, similar to other popular sports leagues in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kho-Kho is a traditional Indian sport that is played by teams of twelve players, of which nine enter the field, who try to avoid being touched by members of the opposing team.
 
• The sport has a rich history and is known for its speed, agility, and teamwork.
 
• The Ultimate Kho-Kho League aims to elevate the sport's status and provide better infrastructure, coaching, and facilities for players.
 
• Efforts are being made to broadcast the matches on various media platforms to reach a wider audience and increase the sport's popularity.
